import json
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/work')
from harness import run, check_plan

FAIL = []


def expect(name, got, want):
    if got != want:
        FAIL.append(name)
        print('FAIL %s\n  got  %s\n  want %s' % (name, json.dumps(got, sort_keys=True),
                                                json.dumps(want, sort_keys=True)))
    else:
        print('ok   %s' % name)


def prep(**kw):
    base = {"op": "prepare", "id": "j1", "owner": "alice", "window": [10, 20],
            "period": 5, "participants": [[0, 1], [1, 1]], "envelope": [[0, 1], [1, 1]],
            "rev": 0}
    base.update(kw)
    return base


LINE = [[0, 1, 10], [1, 2, 10]]

reqs = [
    {"op": "load", "n": 3, "links": LINE, "bookings": []},
    # stale expected revision
    prep(rev=7),
    # reference errors
    prep(participants=[[0, 1], [9, 1]]),
    prep(envelope=[[0, 1], [9, 1]]),
    # window errors
    prep(window=[0, 10], period=5),
    prep(window=[10, 13], period=5),
    # now valid: retry of the same id is allowed
    prep(),
    # replay
    prep(),
    # different payload, same id -> conflict
    prep(period=10),
    # commit errors
    {"op": "commit", "id": "nope", "owner": "alice", "rev": 0},
    {"op": "commit", "id": "j1", "owner": "bob", "rev": 0},
    {"op": "commit", "id": "j1", "owner": "alice", "rev": 5},
    {"op": "commit", "id": "j1", "owner": "alice", "rev": 0},
    # commit replay
    {"op": "commit", "id": "j1", "owner": "alice", "rev": 0},
    # audit shows the lease
    {"op": "audit", "at": [10]},
    # cancelling with the wrong owner
    {"op": "cancel", "id": "j1", "owner": "bob", "rev": 1},
    # cancel with a stale revision
    {"op": "cancel", "id": "j1", "owner": "alice", "rev": 0},
    # cancel
    {"op": "cancel", "id": "j1", "owner": "alice", "rev": 1},
    # commit after cancel -> gone
    {"op": "commit", "id": "j1", "owner": "alice", "rev": 2},
]

out = run(reqs)
expect('prepare stale', out[1], {"status": "stale", "rev": 0})
expect('prepare bad vertex', out[2], {"status": "error", "code": "REFERENCE", "rev": 0})
expect('prepare bad link', out[3], {"status": "error", "code": "REFERENCE", "rev": 0})
expect('prepare window time', out[4], {"status": "error", "code": "TIME", "rev": 0})
expect('prepare window div', out[5], {"status": "error", "code": "WINDOW", "rev": 0})
expect('prepare ok', out[6]["status"], "prepared")
expect('prepare replay', out[7], {"status": "replay", "id": "j1", "rev": 0, "base_rev": 0,
                                   "outcome": "prepared"})
expect('prepare conflict', out[8], {"status": "error", "code": "CONFLICT", "rev": 0})
expect('commit missing', out[9], {"status": "error", "code": "MISSING", "rev": 0})
expect('commit owner', out[10], {"status": "error", "code": "OWNER", "rev": 0})
expect('commit stale', out[11], {"status": "stale", "rev": 0})
expect('commit', out[12], {"status": "ok", "id": "j1", "rev": 1, "replay": False})
expect('commit replay', out[13], {"status": "ok", "id": "j1", "rev": 1, "replay": True})
expect('audit', out[14], {"status": "ok", "rev": 1, "now": 0, "leases": ["j1"],
                          "samples": [[10, [9, 9]]]})
expect('cancel owner', out[15], {"status": "error", "code": "OWNER", "rev": 1})
expect('cancel stale', out[16], {"status": "stale", "rev": 1})
expect('cancel', out[17], {"status": "ok", "rev": 2, "released": "j1"})
expect('commit gone', out[18], {"status": "error", "code": "GONE", "rev": 2})

print()
print('FAILURES: %d' % len(FAIL))
PYEOF
